items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: it was so important because that’s when I first ever saw or met Hoagy Carmichael.

ctx.x: We were a musicians’ band. We didn’t play very much away from the Graystone. Our recordings, always we had to go to New York by train, and so actually we weren’t on the road very much. We played oh, once in a while I remember two senior balls, we played at Notre Dame and University at Indiana, it was so important because that’s when I first ever saw or met Hoagy Carmichael. He and his girl were there that night and after the ball was over, everyone had gone out of the gym except the band, the Goldkette band and…
I wish we had a picture of your home to show everybody.
